buildCommand: mkdir -p bin && V=${YTDLP_VERSION:-latest} && if [ "$V" = latest ]; then U=https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases/latest/download/yt-dlp; else U=https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases/download/$V/yt-dlp; fi && (curl -fsSL "$U" -o bin/yt-dlp && chmod +x bin/yt-dlp && echo 'yt-dlp downloaded') || echo 'yt-dlp download skipped, using InnerTube+Piped fallback' ; npm run build
